items.text: Sales reps who use WhatsApp on their own laptops are the only users.
A message from an unticked chat is never sent anywhere.
Messages are kept on the laptop for 30 days and then deleted.
Importing 500 messages must finish within 5 minutes.
Retries use exponential backoff capped at 5 attempts with idempotency keys.
The chat picker shows a tick box next to every chat.
items.latent_hint: a screen for choosing which chats are copied

items.text: If the laptop is offline, queued messages from an unticked chat are dropped, not sent later.
items.latent_hint: what happens when the laptop is offline

items.text: The rep opens the app, ticks chats once, and then never touches it again.

traps.text: Never sending unticked chats cannot hold if reps never touch the app again after ticking.
traps.resolution: Unticking always wins; reps may change the ticks whenever they like.

traps.text: The import speed is stated vaguely.
traps.resolution: It should be quick, a few minutes at most.

traps.text: What data may leave the laptop is only the person's decision.
traps.resolution: Only the message text and the sender's name may leave the laptop, never phone numbers.

noise.text: Our other team is also looking at a Telegram bot next quarter.
The office coffee machine broke again last week.
